test: stripFountainForExport > Scene Headings > converts standard lowercase scene headings to uppercase
name: stripFountainForExport
args:
int. coffee shop - day

John sits at the bar.

ext. street - night

Rain pours.
expected:
INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

John sits at the bar.

EXT. STREET - NIGHT

Rain pours.

test: stripFountainForExport > Scene Headings > converts I/E, E/I headings and preserves scene numbers
name: stripFountainForExport
args:
i/e moving car - continuous #12A#

They drive fast.
expected:
I/E MOVING CAR - CONTINUOUS #12A#

They drive fast.

test: stripFountainForExport > Scene Headings > converts forced scene headings starting with period to uppercase
